line.en: weekly saturday open mic in english at the alcove on via laietana, 17:00. free to watch, a drink is required, and you sign up on the eventbrite page.
line.de: wöchentliches englischsprachiges open mic am samstag um 17:00 im the alcove an der via laietana. zuschauen gratis, ein getränk ist pflicht, anmeldung über die eventbrite-seite.
line.tr: her cumartesi 17:00'de via laietana'daki the alcove'da ingilizce açık mikrofon. izlemek ücretsiz, bir içecek gerekli, kaydı eventbrite sayfasından yap.

sparks.why: Show Up Go Up, weekly Saturday 17:00 English open mic at The Alcove, Via Laietana, per its current Eventbrite page; the 2026 dates were not listed one by one.
